notes: Site is an Angular SPA (SAP Commerce/Hybris backend, app-root shell, no SSR content) fronted by Akamai. robots.txt (https://www.nitori-net.jp/robots.txt) has no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow (only a Google-CloudVertexBot rule for /ec/search and query-param disallows), so tier access was permitted. TIER 1 (direct HTTP): curl to the SAP Commerce OCC v2 REST API (https://www.nitori-net.jp/occ/v2/nitorinet/catalogs/nitorinetProductCatalog/Online/categories/<code>) returned the site's real, live category hierarchy in JSON. Cross-validated this against https://www.nitori-net.jp/ecstatic/sitemap/sitemap_item_1.xml (1612 indexed PLP URLs). Walked the FULL category tree from all 36 top-level departments found in the sitemap (Appliance, Baby, BathToiletLaundry, Bed, CarpetRugMat, Chair, CupboardApplianceBoard, Cushion, Desk-Officechair, GardeningLeisureOutdoor, Houjin, InteriorLifeGoods, KitchenGoodsTableware, KitchenStorage, Kotatu, Laundry, Lighting_Fixture, Mattress, OfficeBookshelfStationery, OutdoorTravel, Pet, RelaxHealth, Roomwear, SeniorGoods, Shingu, Sofa, Storage-Furniture, StorageRackDresser, StudyDeskChildRoom, TableChair, Tableware, TvStandLivingStorage, etc.) down to every leaf, and grepped the full dump (Japanese + English category names) for Christmas/Halloween/Valentine/New Year/Setsubun/Hinamatsuri/Tango no Sekku/Tanabata/Obon terms. RESULT: the only genuine, live, currently-navigable seasonal/holiday category anywhere on the site is 'Christmas' (クリスマスグッズ) under InteriorLifeGoods (インテリア雑貨), i.e. https://www.nitori-net.jp/ec/cat/InteriorLifeGoods/Christmas/1/ - a pure landing/grouping page linking to 6 children with no product grid of its own. Also tested direct category-code guesses for NewYear/Newyear/Oshogatsu/Shogatsu/Valentine/ValentineDay/Setsubun/Hinamatsuri/TangoNoSekku/Tanabata via the same OCC API - all returned 'Category ... not found', consistent with zero hits in the full-tree dump. One exception: guessing 'Halloween' DID resolve via the OCC API (id 'Halloween', name '(非表示)ハロウィングッズ' with 3 children Halloween_Decorationgoods/Halloween_Goods/Halloween_Illumination, all similarly prefixed '(非表示)' = 'hidden/not displayed'). This category is NOT attached to any live parent in the full InteriorLifeGoods subtree walk (it is an orphaned/deactivated catalog node, presumably a past-season leftover), is not in the sitemap, and is explicitly marked hidden by the site's own CMS convention (same '(非表示)' tag seen on other confirmed-inactive nodes elsewhere in the tree, e.g. OfficeCabinet_telephonestand, Special_size_futonsiki-mattressfolding). It therefore fails the 'genuine, currently site-presented PLP' test and was EXCLUDED - noted here per the absence-documentation requirement. Also found and EXCLUDED two general seasonal-but-not-holiday branches per the boundary rules: LifeSuppliesDailyNecessities > Wintergoods (防寒グッズ, cold-weather goods) and Appliance > Seasonal_Appliance (空調・季節家電: fans/heaters/humidifiers/air cleaners) - both are climate/weather-driven, not tied to a specific festival, so excluded as 'merely seasonal timing' per the rules. TIER 2 (Playwright/Chromium, headless): attempted repeatedly (with and without --disable-http2, multiple retries/timeouts) to render the homepage and individual Christmas PLP URLs to read the on-page product-count text; every attempt failed at the network layer (net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR / net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET) even though curl to the same host succeeded, indicating an environment-level HTTP2 handshake issue with this host rather than a bot-block. Moved to TIER 3. TIER 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, real browser): opened a fresh tab and navigated to the Christmas landing page and each of its 6 children; get_page_text returned the rendered Japanese '<N>件' (N items) counts directly from the live PLP for every child. QTY METHOD: displayed PLP total ('◯件' header), priority-1 per the qty method. Christmas (top) is a pure grouping/landing page (breadcrumb links to the 6 children, zero products of its own) -> is_group:true, qty:null, per the parent/children double-count rule. Its 6 children are true sibling PLPs (each has its own product grid + facet filters, 'related categories' cross-links to the other 5 siblings, not a parent/child relationship to each other) so all 6 were kept as separate rows: Christmas Tree/Set Tree 34, Christmas Illumination/Lights 56, Christmas Ornaments & Balls 114, Christmas Wreath 13, Christmas Party Goods & Tableware 26, Christmas Ornaments/Miscellaneous Decor 48. Note: 'Christmas Ornaments & Balls' (Christmas_BallOrnament, 114件) itself has 4 further grandchildren (Christmas_Ornament/Christmas_Ball/Christmas_Treeskirt/Christmas_Treetopper) surfaced as an in-page sub-nav plus its own 114-item product grid - since the 114 count is the page's own genuine PLP total (not a pure landing page) and the 4 grandchildren are presented as narrowing links within that same listing rather than independent catalog-level siblings, they were treated as subsumed by the 114 and NOT rowed separately, avoiding double-counting. No duplicate-link categories were found (each of the 6 children resolves to a distinct URL/count). Checked Baby, Tableware, KitchenGoodsTableware, GardeningLeisureOutdoor, Roomwear, Shingu, TvStandLivingStorage (has butsudan/Buddhist-altar goods, not a seasonal festival) and all other departments for Setsubun/Hinamatsuri/Tango-no-Sekku/Tanabata/Obon/Valentine baby or kitchen tie-ins - none found. No storewide sale/clearance page was mistaken for a seasonal category.
